_comment: Default tick rules for consent.html. Each tick box found on a form is tested against these rules in order; the first match decides its default. 'match' is tested against the box's label (question + option). 'prompt' and 'option' test the question and the option separately (for Yes/No rows). tick: always | female | male | known (ticked once sex is chosen) | never. Anything that matches no rule is left blank for the clinician to review. Every default can be changed on the page before the pack is built.

rules.match: no (risk|chance|possibility) (that )?I (could|might|may) be pregnant|I am not pregnant

rules.note: The pack includes an information leaflet
